title: ethan-brooks-notes-to-self-2026-03-04
content:
Quick brain dump / daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04

Morning priorities (high):
- [ ] Run kv-cache memory repro on staging (see notes below). If repro holds, create small reproducer and attach to RT-2113.
- [ ] Review + merge PR #5678 (serving-runtime): batching backpressure fix. Left a couple of nits.
- [ ] Finalize canary plan for model-v2 (8-bit quant) rollout today at 15:00 PT. Confirm rollback policy with SRE.

Standup notes (10:00 PT):
- call with infra about Dedicated autoscaler limits — ask for current burst capacity numbers for g4dn and a100 pools. (Avery to follow up)
- Maya: will finish tracing hooks for per-request latency breakdown by route. Share dashboard link once ready.

Investigation: kv-cache memory growth
- Symptoms: memory climbs steadily on long-lived chat sessions, spikes after >1k tokens. Suspect stale KV entries or fold bug in cache eviction.
- Steps to run today:
  1) reproduce locally with load script (scripts/load_kv_repro.py) using sequence length 2048, batch size 8.
  2) run with DEBUG_KV=1, capture /metrics endpoint every 30s.
  3) test both model-v1 and model-v2 (quant).
- Notes: might be related to LRU key not being removed when session token id changes. Add extra logging in kv_cache.py at evict() to confirm.

PRs / code reminders:
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/5678 -> review comments left, confirm unit test for batching edge-case.
- Split large test into smaller pieces to avoid hanging on CI.

Canary rollout plan (15:00 PT):
- Target 5% traffic -> monitor error rate + p50/p95 latencies for 20m windows.
- Watch for increased tail-latency on multi-turn chats. If p99 > 2x baseline OR error-rate > 0.5% -> rollback immediately.
- Contacts: Oncall SRE (pager), Maya (traces), Avery (infra).

Ideas / todo (low):
- Add x-batch-priority header to API to allow callers to opt-out of batching for low-latency games. Prototype in python client.
- Update summarize eval set to include 5 new long-doc prompts (from product request).

Personal / errands:
- [ ] Dentist appointment: 2026-03-06 09:30am - reschedule if conflict with travel.
- [ ] Grocery: milk, eggs, coffee, spinach.
- [ ] Pay credit card before 2026-03-07.

Questions to ask in sync w/ PM:
- Are we comfortable with default cache TTL = 5m or increase to 10m for chat workloads? Cost vs latency tradeoff.
- Can product provide more failing prompt examples for the summarization regression?

Misc notes / links:
- Repro script: scripts/load_kv_repro.py
- Jira: RT-2113 (kv-cache memory growth)
- Confluence deploy checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/serving-runtime-deploy-checklist

End of notes.
